## Is your feature request related to a problem?
Describe the user need or problem this would address.

## Proposed solution
Describe the change you would like to see.

## Who would benefit?
For example, website visitors, customers, engineers, or maintainers.

## Alternatives considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you considered.

## Additional context
Add examples, sketches, or reference links where helpful. Do not include confidential company or customer information.

## Pre-submission checklist
- [ ] I checked for similar existing requests.
- [ ] This suggestion is within the scope of this website/repository.
- [ ] I have not included passwords, access tokens, or private information.
